facts.premium: Among the most informal economies in Thailand; remote upland province
impacts: 91% informal — almost no payslip income; pure seasonal cash flow
Upland-maize prices down ~13–15% YoY; the dominant crop income
Forest-encroachment and watershed rules constrain farm livelihoods
Pickups 21% of fleet for mountainous farm terrain — key collateral
Heritage & nature tourism is a slow-growth income source
Distance and youth outflow limit income diversification
